name: multi_turn_injection_stored_reason
description: The stored policy_reason for a tripped multi-turn injection gate, byte-identical across both SDKs. The decayed score is DELIBERATELY ABSENT from the template: a continuous per-request margin persisted into the audit record is an evasion oracle - anyone with read access can watch the number move across attempts and tune a payload's distance to the threshold. Only categorical facts persist (turn count, which signals fired); full precision stays in-process where the threshold comparison runs. Producers: sdk/src/policy/injection-session.ts formatMultiTurnReason, sdk-python/obsvr/injection_session.py format_multi_turn_reason. Consumers: sdk/tests/unit/injection-session.test.ts, sdk-python/tests/test_parity_features.py. The forbidden_fragments list is the negative pin: no stored reason may ever carry a score again.

cases.reason: Multi-turn injection accumulation reached the threshold over 2 turn(s); this turn's signals: instruction_reference, secrecy_request
Multi-turn injection accumulation reached the threshold over 1 turn(s); this turn's signals: none
Multi-turn injection accumulation reached the threshold over 17 turn(s); this turn's signals: role_pressure

forbidden_fragments.desc: Substrings that must never appear in any formatted reason - each is a shape a persisted score took or could take. Both suites format every case above plus a probe set and assert none of these appear.
